record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace forward cumulative position IDs with reverse nonpadding position IDs: the rightmost occupied position receives 1, its predecessor 2, and padding 0. This anchors positions to recency across variable history lengths; the appended inference mask always receives position 1. Preserve history truncation, final-mask readout, embeddings, bidirectional backbone, scoring, masked-target loss and optimizer. Mirror position construction in prediction.

category_rationales.rationale: Anchor positions to recency across all four category models: the rightmost occupied position receives ID 1, preceding occupied positions receive increasing IDs, and padding remains 0. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so appended-mask inference uses the identical position construction without changing checkpoint shapes.
